basis: Direct first opening of canonical 10p/figures/fig-70.png, before reading the author's FigureSpec, source-inventory, construction script, edition prose or solutions. Only freeze provenance metadata and file names had been read.

conventions.rows: Top-to-bottom a,b,c,d,e,f are my Latin names for the source's six Cyrillic subfigure labels.
conventions.displacements: Signs are relative to that row's horizontal equilibrium guide, positive above it. Fractions below express visually equal relative levels, not a measured source axis or a claim of exact pixel precision.
conventions.velocity: up/down means an explicit short vertical velocity arrow at that ball; absent means no such arrow. Zero displacement at an advancing front does not mean stationary.

structure.identity: Numbered 1 through 18 on every row, in the same increasing left-to-right order and approximately equal horizontal spacing. A ball retains its horizontal station across snapshots; only transverse displacement changes.
structure.connections: Every row is a continuous chain from ball 1 through ball 18, connecting all 17 adjacent pairs. Behind the front the chain bends; ahead it remains straight on the horizontal equilibrium guide.
structure.equilibriumGuides: Each snapshot has a horizontal equilibrium line across the same stations. Off-equilibrium balls have thin vertical projection guides back to it; these are not velocity arrows.
structure.amplitude: The second row has a left-side vertical double-headed amplitude span A between its equilibrium and ball 1's upper extremum.
structure.propagation: The disturbed portion grows from the left. This is not a pre-existing steady sine wave across all 18 balls.

rows.observations: All 18 numbered balls share the equilibrium chain; no short velocity arrows or vertical displacement projections. Right-side time is 0.

Ball 1 is at the crest, then 2 and 3 decrease toward the first equilibrium crossing at 4; 2 is higher than 3. Ball 4 has an upward velocity arrow despite zero displacement. The 4-to-18 continuation is horizontal. The separate A dimension at far left must not become a ball-1 velocity arrow.

Positive half-wave from equilibrium ball 1 through crest 4 to equilibrium/front ball 7. Ball 1 moves down, 7 moves up; crest 4 has no velocity arrow. Higher 3 and 5 lie symmetrically about 4, as do lower 2 and 6.

Ball 1 is the trough; 2 is lower than 3 (these are not equal-height points), then crossing 4, positive crest 7, and upward-moving front 10. The positive hump is symmetric in pairs 5/9 and 6/8. There is no velocity arrow at trough 1 or crest 7.

rows.observations: One spatial cycle now occupies 1-to-13: upward zero 1, trough 4, downward zero 7, crest 10, upward zero/front 13. Balls 14-to-18 are still unreached, not a continuation of the sine. The dimension's endpoint guides drop from stations 1 and 13.

rows.observations: Crest 1, downward spatial crossing 4, trough 7, upward spatial crossing 10, crest 13, then front 16. Time velocities are opposite the slope of this rightward-traveling profile: 2-to-6 up, 8-to-12 down, 14-to-16 up. No arrow at extrema 1/7/13. Balls 17/18 are flat and stationary. Extended dimension guides descend from 2/14 and 3/15; the two lambda spans must not be silently replaced by crest-to-crest 1/13.

crossSnapshotRelationships.frontAdvance: Three inter-ball intervals per quarter-period snapshot.
crossSnapshotRelationships.periodOfBall1: Equilibrium 0, crest at T/4, equilibrium moving down at T/2, trough at 3T/4, equilibrium moving up at T, crest at 5T/4.
crossSnapshotRelationships.neighborLag: Disturbance proceeds toward increasing ball number, while individual balls remain at fixed horizontal stations.
crossSnapshotRelationships.extremumVelocity: No short velocity arrows at reached extrema; zero displacement alone does not distinguish moving crossings from the unreached flat tail.

sourceAndModernization.sourceVisibleText: Number labels 1..18, six source subfigure markers, six time labels, A and three lambda labels.
sourceAndModernization.culturalFacts: The drawing is a neutral mechanical ball-chain model. No people, national emblems, uniforms or social scenario. Source row markers are Cyrillic and should become Latin/English labels; Greek lambda and mathematical T/A are allowed.
sourceAndModernization.additionsNotSourceFacts: An exact sinusoidal parametrization, uniform regularized coordinates, color accents, alternative line weights, headers or a legend would be modern explanatory additions, not measured source givens.
sourceAndModernization.answerLeakage: The original already marks wavelength; retaining those three source-given spans is not newly supplying an answer.

uncertainties: This source raster is small and hand-drawn. Relative signs, extrema, arrow directions, point order and span endpoints are clear; subpixel spacing and arrow lengths are not numeric givens.
